update.title: Fixed artifact rendering across the portfolio pipeline
update.summary: Aligned Work Report previews, Portfolio Editor path handling, saved media, and detail-page blocks so artifacts remain usable from report intake through the rendered page.

blocks.body:
## Make every artifact recognizable before import

Work Report cards preview image, code, terminal, video, document, and data evidence before it enters a draft. When staged material still carries an absolute filesystem path, Portfolio Editor's preview bridge routes it through the artifact-preview endpoint and supplies the live page with a valid preview URL.

blocks.description: Work Report card titled Test: All 6 artifact types with preview cards for image, code, terminal, video, document, and data evidence. Work Report cards distinguish all six evidence categories before they enter the draft.

blocks.body:
## Preserve artifacts through save and render

Saving copies local video alongside other asset-bearing blocks and rewrites its source to a project-relative media path. The detail renderer uses native video playback for local files and an iframe for supported hosted media. Shared path resolution covers images, galleries, comparisons, and PDFs through the same preview and save flow.

flowchart LR
  Report[Work Report card] --> Draft[Editor draft]

  Draft --> Media[Saved project media]

blocks.description: One artifact keeps a traceable path from its Work Report preview through editor state and saved portfolio output.
